bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks, hard-sided bags, luggage, coolers and bags over 16 × 16 inches are prohibited. Every admitted bag is manually checked; some concerts impose stricter bag limits.
allowed: Bag up to 16 × 16 inches when the concert allows
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Nearby parking facilities are operated separately from the theater; consult the theater parking map and allow additional time on show days.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The theater parking page promotes rideshare but does not specify an official pickup point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Concessions are cash-free and accept payment cards and mobile wallets. Guests with valid ID may buy no more than two alcoholic beverages per transaction.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: An accessible ramp reaches the front entrance; the theater publishes details about accessible seating and support.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: For the permitted outdoor smoking break, scan your ticket out in the Ticket Lobby and then back in and repeat the security check. Smoking access closes 30 minutes before the scheduled end of a show.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office is just inside the main Market Street entrance; the operator lists updated hours on its box-office page.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Doors typically open one hour before the event; use the exact opening time in the event-day email. Bags are inspected by security.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
